question: Which of the following countries was the host of the ICC World Test Championship Cricket final played between India and New Zealand from 18-23 June 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**England**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **England** was the host of the ICC World Test Championship Cricket final played between India and New Zealand from 18-23 June 2021.
 
• The match was held at the **Rose Bowl** in Southampton, England.
 
• The ICC World Test Championship is an international cricket competition run by the International Cricket Council (ICC).
 
• The final match saw New Zealand emerge victorious, claiming the championship title.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ICC World Test Championship was introduced to bring context and relevance to Test cricket, which is considered the longest and most traditional format of the game.
 
• The championship aims to crown the best Test cricket team in the world over a two-year period.
 
• Teams earn points based on their performance in Test matches played during the championship period.
 
• The top two teams at the end of the period compete in the final to determine the winner.
 
• The inaugural ICC World Test Championship began in 2019 and concluded with the final in 2021.
